color-by-number.players: Omuntu 1 oba 2, batudde kumpi ne munne
color-by-number.intro: Akatimba k'ebibinja ebinene, buli kimu nga kirimu namba, era waggulu waakyo waliwo ekitabo ky'langi ennya, buli emu nga erimu namba yaayo n'erinnya lyayo mu buwandiike. Londa langi okuva mu kitabo ekyo, oluvannyuma kuba ebibinja okubijjuza. Akatimba katandika nga 4 ku 4, n'ekisoboka okweyongerayo okutuuka ku 6 ku 6 ne 8 ku 8 ng'oyagala ebibinja ebisingawo. Buli kibinja bwe kirifuna langi ya namba yaakyo, akatimba kaba ekifaananyi ekiri ku lupapula. Ebibinja ebijjuzibwa langi endala yonna bifuuka ekifaananyi kyo ky'oyiiyiyeko, era omuzannyo tegyogera ku ekyo. Bbaatuuni "Jjuza ng'okozesa namba" ejjuza ebibinja byonna ebitaliimu langi.
howTo: Londa obunene bw'akatimba. 4 ku 4 bulina ebibinja ebinene ennyo era bwe bwangu okusinga.
Laba ekitabo ky'langi waggulu w'akatimba. Langi nnyinnyi erina namba n'erinnya, gamba nga 1 Kiragala.
Kuba langi mu kitabo, oluvannyuma kuba ebibinja by'oyagala okujjuzibwa nayo.
Kozesa langi ya namba, oba langi yonna gy'oyagala. Byombi bikkirizibwa.
Kuba "Jjuza ng'okozesa namba" ku bibinja ebitaliimu langi, "Ddamu" okutandika akatimba buto, oba "Ekifaananyi ekirala" ekirala.
tips: Mutuule kumpi ne munne mukyukakyuke: omu alonda langi, omulala akuba ekibinja.
Yogera ku langi: "Njagala ekiragala." Tekyetaagisa kwogera ekifaananyi kijja kuba ki.
Ku ssirini entono, akatimba aka 8 ku 8 kakyukira ku mabbali munda mu bbokisi yaakyo. Ebibinja bisigala nga binene bulungi.
Ekiwandiiko ky'olupapula nakyo kikola bulungi n'obupensulo ku mmeeza ey'ekitanda.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa, bubonero, kubala kwa njega wadde okufiirwa. Osobola okuyimirira mu kiseera kyonna, era okuyimirira wakati nakyo kiwera kya kumaliriza bulungi.

faq.q: Kiki ekibaawo bwe nkozesa langi eya njawulo ku ya namba?
faq.a: Tewali ekikyuka, era ekyo kye kigendererwa. Langi yonna esobola okuteekebwa mu kibinja kyonna, era omuzannyo tegyogera ku ekyo. Buli kibinja bwe kirifuna langi ya namba yaakyo, omuzannyo gugyogerako mu ngeri ey'ekisa, era ekifaananyi mu langi zo wekka kirungi nga bwe kiri.

faq.q: Langi ennya zisobola okwawulwa abantu abalina obuzibu bw'okulaba langi?
faq.a: Zaalondebwa okusobola ekyo. Buli langi erina namba, erinnya mu buwandiike n'ekifaananyi kyayo ekitono, n'olwekyo langi tebeera ntegeeza yokka ey'okwawulamu. Langi ennya zaakeberebwa n'okukoppa obuzibu bw'okulaba emyufu n'obwendo, era era zaawukana mu bumyufu. Omuntu alina obuzibu bw'okulaba langi tannagezaako, n'olwekyo tutegeeze bwe langi bbiri zirabika ng'ezifaanagana.

faq.q: Ebibinja binene okusobola okukozesebwa omuntu ayuuguumirwa oba ssirini entono?
faq.a: Buli kibinja kiri waakiri ppikisero 48 mu bugazi, era 56 ku katimba ka 4 ku 4. Akatimba bwe kaba kanene nnyo ku ssirini, kakyukira ku mabbali munda mu bbokisi yaakyo mu kifo ky'okukendeeza ebibinja.
Yee. Olupapula lumu lulina akatimba k'ebibinja ebirimu namba n'ekitabo ky'langi ennya n'amannya gazo. Langi buli kibinja n'obupensulo obw'langi ya namba yakyo, oba langi yonna gy'oyagala.
Ee, kya bwereere, era tewali akaunti, kwewandiisa wadde okutikka. Kikola mu bulaawuzi ya yintaneti ku ssimu, ttabuleti oba kompyuta.

pattern-maker.name: Omukozi w'ebifaananyi ebiddiŋŋana
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Omukozi w'ebifaananyi ebiddiŋŋana: Kola ekipande olabe nga kiddiŋŋana
pattern-maker.h1: Omukozi w'ebifaananyi ebiddiŋŋana: Kola ekipande, olabe nga kiddiŋŋana
pattern-maker.description: Kyusa ebibinja by'ekipande ekitono olabe nga kiddiŋŋana ng'ekiri ku ruuyi, mu langi ennya buli emu erina erinnya n'ekifaananyi kyayo. Tewali saawa wadde obubonero. Kizannyirwa era kisobola okusiigibwa mu bwereere.
pattern-maker.short: Kyusa ebibinja by'ekipande ekitono olabe nga kiddiŋŋana mu kifaananyi.
pattern-maker.players: Omuntu 1 oba 2, batudde kumpi ne munne
pattern-maker.intro: Ekipande ekitono ekya ebibinja 3 ku 3, oba 4 ku 4 bw'oyagala, n'ku ruuyi lwakyo "ekifaananyi kyo": ekipande kimu nga kiddiŋŋana mu kibinja. Kuba ekibinja kikyuke mu langi ddala eddako mu ennya, buli emu nga erina erinnya lyayo mu buwandiike n'ekifaananyi kyayo. Ekifaananyi ekiri ku ruuyi kikyuka mangu. Tewali kifaananyi ekituufu, era tewali ekitereekebwa wadde ekisindikibwa. Bbaatuuni "Siiga ekifaananyi kyange" eteeka ekifaananyi ekiddiŋŋana ku lupapula limu okukikuumira, okusiigako langi oba okukiwa abalala.
howTo: Laba ekipande n'ekifaananyi kyo ekiri ku ruuyi. Bye bimu, ekipande kimu nga kiddiŋŋana.
Kuba ekibinja. Kikyuka okudda mu langi eddako mu lunyiriri lwa langi ennya waggulu.
Kuba ebibinja okutuusa ekifaananyi lwe kirabika nga bwe wandyagadde. Buli kifaananyi kirungi.
Kuba "Nsanyusa" okufuna ekipande ekipya, oba "Tandika buto" okufuna ekitaliiko kintu. "Ddiza" ezzaawo ekipande kye wali olina.
Kuba "Siiga ekifaananyi kyange" bw'oyagala okukiteeka ku lupapula, oba kuba Wummula okuyimirira.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "That looks like a flower." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali saawa, muwendo gwa bubonero, muwendo gw'okukyusa wadde okufiirwa. Osobola okuyimiriza essaawa yonna, era okuyimiriza wakati nakyo kyeyoleka ng'engeri ennungi ey'okumaliriza.

faq.q: Ekyo kye nkoze kitereddwa oba kitumiddwa?
faq.a: Nedda. Akatimba ko kasigala ku lupapula luno lwokka. Tekatereddwa, tekayisibwa wadde okubalibwa, era kibula bw'osalawo okuggalawo olupapula. Bw'oba oyagala okukuuma endabika, ogiprinte.

faq.q: Kiki bwe nnyoola akasanja ak'enkyukakyuka oba ne nsangula akatimba mu bukyamu?
faq.a: Tewali kasanja kakyamu: kinnyiriza omulundi ogwokubiri okwolekera langi eddako. Oluvannyuma lwa "Tandika buto" oba "Nsanyuse", "Zzaayo" eddizaayo akatimba kewe wali.

faq.q: Abantu abataawulamu langi basobola okwawulawo langi ezo ennya?
faq.a: Zaalondebwa okusobola okwawulika. Langi nganye erina erinnya lyayo mu buwandiike era n'ekifaananyi ekitono ekyayo mu buli kasanja, kale langi teri yokka ekozesebwa okwawula. Langi ennya zakeberebwa n'okukozesa ebifaananyi ebikwata ku buzibu bw'okulaba langi emmyufu ne kiragala n'obubuvu ne kya kitaka. Omuntu omulina obuzibu bw'okulaba langi tannaba kuzikozesa, kale tutegeeze singa ebbiri ziraba ng'ezifaanagana.

faq.q: Obutundutundu bunene okutuukana n'omukono oguyuuguuka oba essiga ettono?
faq.a: Buli kasanja kalina obugazi bwa pikseli 56 ddala ddala. Akatimba bwe kaba kasinga obugazi bw'essiga, kakyuka mu ludda lwa kkono ne ddyo munda mu lufuba lwakyo, so si okukendeeza obunene bw'obutundutundu.

Weewaawo. "Printa akatimba kange" eprinta akatimba ko wamu n'ebiwandiiko byako ku lupapula lumu, n'enkyukakyuka ennya n'amannya gaazo. Kirabika bulungi nga kya kitaka n'ekiddugavu, kubanga langi nganye erina ekifaananyi kyayo.
Weewaawo, kya busa, era tewetaagisa akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuwanula. Kikola mu bbaluzaali ya yintaneeti ku ssimu, kompyuta oba taabuleeti.

drawing-duet.name: Okukuba ebifaananyi awamu
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Okukuba Ebifaananyi Awamu: Abantu Babiri, Ekifaananyi Kimu
drawing-duet.h1: Okukuba Ebifaananyi Awamu: Abantu Babiri, Olupapula Lumu
drawing-duet.description: Abantu babiri bakyusakyusa okukuba emirongo ku kisubi ekimu ekya bonna, nga buli omu akozesa langi ye. Tewali abala bitundu wadde okuwangula, era ekifaananyi kisobola okutereka oba okuprinta. Kizannyibwa mu bwereere, awatali akawunti.
drawing-duet.short: Kyusakyusa okukuba ekifaananyi kimu ekya bonna n'omuntu akuliraanye.
drawing-duet.intro: Kisubi kimu, abantu babiri. Buli omu alonda langi ye, era buli langi erina erinnya lyayo mu buwandiike. Mukyusakyusa: okuba omurongo oba ekifaananyi kimu, olwo n'owaayo peni. Buli omu asobola okuyisa omulundi gwonna. Tewali kifaananyi ekituufu wadde essuubi lyokuwangula. Tereka ekifaananyi ku kyuma kyo bw'okyagala, oba oprinte olupapula: lupapula lumu, peni bbiri.
howTo: Buli omu alonde langi ye. Ekibaluwa kiraga omuntu alina omukisa, nga kiriko n'erinnya ly'alangi ye.
Kuba omurongo oba ekifaananyi n'engalo, mawo oba peni. Oba kozesa obusaale n'ekitaano (Space) okukuba awatali kawuwuzi.
Bw'oba weetegese, nyiga "Waayo peni". Buli omu asobola okuyisa omulundi gwonna.
Nyiga "Ggyawo omurongo gwange ogwasembayo" okuggyawo omurongo ogw'oluvannyuma ogw'omuntu alina omukisa.
Nyiga "Tereka ekifaananyi" okukola fayiro y'ekifaananyi ku kyuma kino, oba "Printa olupapula" olupapula lumu ne peni bbiri.
tips: Mutudde kumpi wamu era mwogerageranye nga mukuba: "Nja kussaako enjuba mu nsonda."
Tandika n'akatonnyeezi, omurongo oba ekifaananyi ekyangu, era leka omuntu omulala akiddamu.
Tewali kiragiro nti olina okukuba ekifaananyi ky'ekintu kyonna. Ekifaananyi ky'emirongo kirungi nga ekifaananyi ekirimu emboozi.
Bw'oba oyagala okuyimiriza, nyiga "Nkoze bulungi okutuusa kati". Ekifaananyi kyo tekikuumibwa ng'ova ku lupapula, okuggyako ng'okitereka.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali awangula, tewali muwendo gwa bubonero, tewali saawa wadde okubala emirundi gy'okuyitawo. Tewali kifaananyi ekituufu, era tewali kigeraageranyizibwa wadde okuteekebwa mu nkola.

Nedda, tewali kintu kitumiddwa wadde wa. Ekifaananyi kisigala ku lupapula luno okutuusa ng'olumaliriza. Bw'onyiga Tereka ekifaananyi, fayiro ekolebwa ku kyuma kyo gy'osobola okuwanula. Tewali kiteekebwa ku yintaneeti.
Yee. "Ggyawo omurongo gwange ogwasembayo" eggyawo omurongo ogw'oluvannyuma ogw'omuntu alina omukisa. "Tandika buto" eggyawo ekifaananyi kyonna, ne "Zzaayo" ezzaayo emirongo, omutendera gumu gwokka.

faq.q: Nsobola okukozesa bino nga sirina mawo wadde essiga erikwata?
faq.a: Yee. Ekifaananyi bwe kiba kiri mu maaso go, obusaale bukyusa akatonnyeezi ka peni, ate ekitaano (Space) kiteeka peni wansi oba kiggyayo waggulu. Essiga lyogera nti "Peni wansi" oba "Peni waggulu" buli lwe kikolebwa.

faq.q: Langi ziruwa, era abantu abataawulamu langi basobola okuzawulamu?
faq.a: Kiyirro, kiragala, kiwoowo ne kya kitaka, langi ennya ezikozesebwa mu bizannyo byaffe ebirala eby'ebifaananyi. Buli emu erina erinnya mu buwandiike, era amannya gaalagibwa okuliraana omulundi gw'omuntu. Langi zaakeberebwa n'okukozesa ebifaananyi ebikwata ku njawulo ya langi ezitera okubaawo, naye omuntu alina enjawulo y'okulaba langi tannaba kuzikozesa.
Weewaawo. "Printa olupapula" eprinta olupapula lumu nga liriko amateeka, ne ddirisa ennene enzirugavu omuyinza okukubamu, ku bantu babiri ne peni bbiri. Kikola bulungi nga kya kitaka n'ekiddugavu.
Ee, kya ddala era tewali kusasula, era tewali akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuwanula. Likola ku mukutu gwa intaneeti ku ssimu, ku kompyuta ento oba ku kompyuta.

build-together.name: Okuzimba awamu
build-together.seoTitle: Okuzimba Awamu: Abantu Babiri Bazimba Ekifaananyi Kimu
build-together.h1: Okuzimba Awamu: Abantu Babiri, Akatimba Kamu
build-together.description: Abantu babiri bakyusa obutereevu okuteeka ekitundu mu katimba akagabana okutuusa lwe kajjula, buli omu alina langi ye ery'enjawulo erinnya lyayo n'ekifaananyi kyayo. Tewali awangula, tewali sekkomo wadde okubalirira. Kisaasa okuzannya era n'okukisiiga.
build-together.short: Kyusa obutereevu n'omuntu ali kumpi naawe okujjuza akatimba kamu akagabana.
build-together.intro: Akatimba akagabana ak'ebifo 4 ku 4, oba 3 ku 3 bw'oyagala. Buli omu alonda langi, era buli langi lirina erinnya lyayo eriwandiikiddwa n'ekifaananyi kyayo. Mukyusa obutereevu: mu kiseera kyo, kuba ekifo ekitaliimu kikutunda okuteeka ekitundu kyo omwo. Ekifo kyonna bwe kirimu ekitundu, ekifaananyi kizimbiddwa awamu. Tewali awangula, kubanga mukizimba nga bombi, era tewali ekitereka wadde ekisindikibwa. "Siiga akatimba" kiteeka akatimba akatalimu kintu ku lupapula lumu, mulyoke muzimbe n'obupensulo bubiri.
howTo: Buli omu alonde langi. Langi omuntu omulala gy'alina ekolebwa nti "Ekozesebwa".
Omuntu asooka akola ekisooka. Ekitundu kiraga ani ku lukyo n'langi ye.
Kuba ekifo ekitaliimu okuteeka ekitundu kyo omwo. Olukyo luyita eri omuntu omulala.
Bw'oba toyagala kuteeka kitundu, kuba "Leka". Buli omu asobola okuleka mu kiseera kyonna.
Ekifo kyonna bwe kirimu ekitundu, mube mwazimba ekifaananyi awamu. Kuba "Tandika buggya" okuzimba omulala, oba kuba Wummula okuyimirira.
tips: Mutudde kumpi, mulyoke mombi mulabe era mutuuke ku kitangaala. Yogera nga mukola: "Nze nja kuteeka ekange ku kyo."
Gezaako okuzimba enkola, enkoona, akakoola oba ensalo, oba oteeke ebitundu wonna gy'oyagala. Byombi bisaana.
Omwana oba omuntu akoowa mangu asobola okuleka emirundi gyonna gy'ayagala. Ekifaananyi kikyazimbibwa awamu.
Ku lupapula, buli omu akozesa obupensulo bumu n'okuwandika ekifaananyi kye mu bifo ebitaliimu.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali awangula, kubanga mukizimba ekifaananyi kimu awamu. Tewali saawa, sekkomo, kubala bitundu wadde okufiirwa. Oyinza okuyimirira ku kiseera kyonna, era okuyimiririra wakati nakyo kiyinza okuba engeri ennungi ey'okumaliriza.

faq.q: Ebyo bye tukola bitereekebwa oba bisindikibwa?
faq.a: Nedda. Akatimba kasigala ku lupapula luno lwokka. Tekutereekebwa, tekusindikibwa wadde okubalibwa, era kibula bw'oggalawo olupapula. Bw'oyagala okukuuma, siiga akatimba omuzimbe ku lupapula.

faq.q: Nga nteeka ekitundu mu kifo ekitali kituufu?
faq.a: Tewali kifo ekitali kituufu. Kuba "Ddamu ekitundu ekisembayo" olukyo ne ludda gy'oli. Oyinza okuddamu emitendera gimu ku gimu, era n'okuleka nakyo kiyinza okuddamu.

faq.q: Langi ennya zisobola okwawulwa abantu abalina obulwadde bw'amaaso ag'okulaba langi?
faq.a: Zalondebwa bwe zityo. Buli langi era erina erinnya lyayo eriwandiikiddwa n'ekifaananyi kyayo ekitono mu buli kitundu, kale langi teri yokka ekiyinza okuzawulamu. Langi ennya zakeberebwa n'okukozesa ebifaananyi ebiraga obulwadde bw'amaaso ag'okulaba langi obwa emmyufu n'ekiragala ne bbuluu n'engeri. Omuntu alina obulwadde bw'amaaso ag'okulaba langi tannaba kuzikozesa, kale tutegeeze bw'ogwa nti langi ebbiri zifaanana.

faq.q: Ebifo binene okutuukiriza omuntu alina okukankana oba ekitabo ekitono?
faq.a: Buli kifo kiri ku bunene bwa pikisiseli 56 ku mpande zombi. Akatimba bwe kaba kagazi okusinga essirini, kasereba ku mabbali munda mu kasanduuko yakyo mu kifo ky'okukendeeza ebifo.

Yee. "Siiga akatimba" kisiiga akatimba akatalimu kintu ku lupapula lumu, nga mulimu langi zombi n'amannya gaazo, mulyoke muzimbe n'obupensulo bubiri. Kikola mu ddoboozi ery'ekitangaala n'ekyeru kubanga buli langi erina ekifaananyi kyayo.
Ee, kya ddala era tewali kusasula, era tewali akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuwanula. Likola ku mukutu gwa intaneeti ku ssimu, ku kompyuta ento oba ku kompyuta.

seated-toss.name: Okusuula ng'otudde
seated-toss.seoTitle: Okusuula ng'Otudde: Omuzannyo gwa Kiwago Ogw'Abantu Babiri
seated-toss.h1: Okusuula ng'Otudde: Musuule Awamu ku Mmeeza
seated-toss.description: Abantu babiri ku mmeeza bakyusa obutereevu okusuula ekiwago ekipapu mu katimba kanene, era bakuuma okubala ku lupapula. Tewali kiseera kibalibwa wadde amanota. Kisaasa okukisiiga.
seated-toss.short: Kyusa obutereevu okusuula ekiwago ku katimba kanene, n'okubala ku lupapula.
seated-toss.intro: Omuzannyo ogw'okusuula ogw'emirembe ku bantu babiri abatudde ku mmeeza. Omuteeka akatimba akasiigiddwa ku mmeeza mukyusa obutereevu okusuula ekiwago ekipapu, oba essoole eryeemuluddwa, galuke ku mpeta. Buli omu akuuma okubala nga bakubako obukonge ku lupapula, era mulaba obukonge awamu bwe muyimiriza. Tewali kiseera kibalibwa, tewali kikubibwa ku ssirini, era tewali ekitereka wadde ekisindikibwa. Wabula soma ebiragiro by'obukuumi nga tebinnatandika: ebintu ebitono ebiri munda bisobola okuziyiza omukka.
howTo: Soma ebiragiro by'obukuumi. Londa ekiwago ekiriko ekikuubo ekisibiddwa, oba eyeemuluza essoole ennongoofu.
Kuba "Siiga katimba n'olupapula lw'okubala" osiige olupapula nga lugalaamye ku mmeeza wakati wammwe.
Tudde bulungi, buli omu ku ludda lwe, era mukyusa obutereevu nga buli omu asuula omulundi gumu mpola. Omuntu yenna asobola okuleka.
Okusuula kwe kugwa mu mpeta, kuba akabokisi ku mutindo gwa buli mpeta mu lunyiriri lw'olukalala lwo.
Mulabe obukonge awamu bwe muyimiriza, oba kuba Wummula okuyimirira okuwummula.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "Ee, ekyo kyali kirungi." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali kaduwa, score, muwendo gwa kutambula oba okufiirwa. Oyinza okuyimirira mu kiseera kyonna, era okuyimirira wakati nakyo kye kimu ku ngeri ennungi ey'okumaliriza.

Kiyinza okuba kirungi, bw'oba weegendereza. Kozesa ensawo ekutuddwamu oba essock eyeekulukuunyizibwa, so si bbiini ezitali mu nsawo, omuceere oba ebintu ebitono ebirimu, kubanga bisobola okuziyiza empewo eri abaana abato n'omuntu yenna ateeka ebintu mu kamwa. Tuula, suula mpola okutunuulira emmeeza so si mu maaso g'omuntu, era weeyambire omuntu omukulu ali kumpi.

faq.q: Waliwo ekibalirirwa oba ekiterekebwa ku ssirini?
faq.a: Nedda. Okubala kukolebwa ku mpapula yokka, mu masanduuko mwe mukuba akabonero mmwe bennyini. Olupapula terekebwa kubalirira wadde ekiseera, era tewali kiterekebwa oba kisindikibwa.

faq.q: Ani bw'atasobola kusuula, oba ensawo bw'egwa ebweru w'olupapula?
faq.a: Buli muntu asobola okuyisa, n'ensawo egwa ebweru w'olupapula eddibwa okusuulibwa mu kiseera ekiddako. Tewali kibalibwa olw'ekyo.

Olupapula lumu: ekiruubirirwa ekinene n'empeta zaakyo ssatu ezimanyiddwa nga Okumpi, Wakati ne Ewala, emmeeza erina column ya buli muntu n'ennyiriri z'obusanduuko obutono obw'okukuba akabonero ku buli mpeta, ne laini ya amagezi g'obukuumi. Amannya gawandiikiddwa ku mpeta, kale kikola ne mu langi enzirugavu n'ekitangaala.
Yee, kiwereddwa obwereere, era tewali akawunti, kiwandiiko oba okukka wansi. Kikola ku browser y'omutimbaganyi ku ssimu, tabuleti oba kompyuta.

seasonal-pack.name: Ekipande ky'ebigambo by'ebiseera
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Ekipande ky'Ebigambo by'Ebiseera: Ebigambo ku Mpapula Ebisobola Okusiigibwa
seasonal-pack.h1: Ekipande ky'Ebigambo by'Ebiseera: Ebigambo Bisatu ku Mpapula ku Buli Biseera
seasonal-pack.description: Ebigambo bisatu ebitono ebisobola okusiigibwa ku bbanga ly'ebiseera: ebiseera by'ensi, ebbugumu, ebiseera by'amakungula oba obutiti: kwata ebiri ebyenkana, zingiza ekintu ekyawukana, era langa ekifaananyi. Londa ekiseera, oba twala olunaku lw'okuwummulamu. Kisiigibwa bwereere.
seasonal-pack.short: Ebigambo bisatu ebisobola okusiigibwa ku kiseera ky'olonda, oba olunaku lw'okuwummulamu.
seasonal-pack.intro: Londa ekiseera, olupapula lulaga ebigambo bisatu ebitono ebya mpapula ebiva ku bifaananyi by'ekiseera ekyo: emitiro ibiri okusiba n'emitiro, olunyiriri lwa bana okuzingiza ekyawukana, ne ekifaananyi okulangibwa. Osiiga olupapula lumu, olwo okole kimu, bibiri oba byonna bisatu, mu bwangu bwo. Londa "Leero lunaku lwa kuwummulamu" mu kifo ky'ekyo, tewali ky'olina kukola.
howTo: Londa ekiseera, oba londa "Leero lunaku lwa kuwummulamu".
Laba ebigambo bisatu, oluvannyuma kuba "Siiga ekipande ky'ekiseera kino".
Kola kimu, bibiri oba byonna bisatu, mu bwangu bwo.
Siba ebifaananyi ebifaanagana n'omutiro, zingiza ekyawukana, era langa ekifaananyi ekinene.
Yimirira ddala ddala bw'oyagala. Olunaku lw'okuwummulamu nalwo lulungi.
tips: Tandika n'ebigambo ebisinga okuba ebyangu leero. Kimu kimala.
Yogera erinnya lya buli kifaananyi n'eddoboozi waggulu, bw'kiyamba.
Kozesa crayons oba penseri. Langi yonna nnungi.
Terekera olupapula olw'omulundi ogujja, oba bulekeere.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali kaduwa, score, muwendo gwa kutambula oba okufiirwa. Oyinza okuyimirira mu kiseera kyonna, era okuyimirira wakati nakyo kye kimu ku ngeri ennungi ey'okumaliriza.

faq.q: Olupapula lumanyi ekiseera kye tuli mu?
faq.a: Nedda. Ggwe olonda ekiseera. Olupapula talaba ggwanga oba ekifo kyo.
Nedda. Tewali kibalirirwa kiseera, score oba okukeberebwa ku ssirini, era tewali ky'okuddamu ekiraga. Buli bigambo kifaananyi kya kulaba, okuzingiza, okusiba oba okulangira bwereere.

faq.q: Kiki singa tewali ayagala bigambo leero?
faq.a: Londa "Leero lunaku lwa kuwummulamu". Olwo olupapula lulaga omutiro gumu omutereevu, era tewali kiwandiikibwa oba okukolebwa.
Olupapula lumu ku kiseera kye walonda: ebigambo byakyo bisatu, buli kimu nga kirina omutiro omumpi ogw'engeri y'okukolamu, n'omutiro ogulaga nti oyinza okukola kimu, bibiri oba byonna bisatu.
Yee, kiwereddwa obwereere, era tewali akawunti, kiwandiiko oba okukka wansi. Kikola ku browser y'omutimbaganyi ku ssimu, tabuleti oba kompyuta.

decorate-a-card.name: Yiiyiza kaadi awamu
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Yiiyiza Kaadi Awamu: Kaadi y'Okulamusa Esobola Okusiigibwa
decorate-a-card.h1: Yiiyiza Kaadi Awamu: Kola Emu Eri Omuntu
decorate-a-card.description: Abantu babiri biyiiyiza kaadi y'okulamusa esiigiddwa ku lunaku lw'amazaalibwa, okwebaza oba awatali nsonga, oluvannyuma ne bawandiika obubaka ku ddyo awamu. Crayons oba peni zokka. Tewali kibalirirwa kiseera oba score. Kisiigibwa bwereere.
decorate-a-card.intro: Kizannyo kya kukola ekikakkanyavu eri abantu babiri ababa batudde kumpi ne bannaabwe. Osiiga olupapula lumu, olukupya okufuuka kaadi. Londa ensonga, gamba ng'olunaku lw'amazaalibwa oba okwebaza, oluvannyuma oyiiyize ku ngulu ng'ekolagana n'ebigambo byayo. Oluvannyuma wandiika obubaka ku ddyo, awamu oba omu n'awandiika ebyo omulala by'ayogera. Kozesa crayons, penseri za langi oba peni ezirina ekinywa. Tewali kaadi entuufu, era tewali kibalirirwa kiseera, score oba kutumibwa.
howTo: Chagua mu biseera, oluvannyuma nnyiga "Print the card".
Windika olupapula wakati ogwa ku laini ezikutuddwa, ekitundu ky'okungulu kibe kiri ebweru.
Omu ayonja ekitundu ky'omu maaso, omulala ayonja ekitundu ky'emabega, oba mukyusa ku ludda lumu.
Wandiika ebbaluwa awamu. Omu asobola okuwandiika ate omulala ayogera ebigambo.
Yimiriza buli lw'oyagala. Kaadi ennyangu nayo ya nsonga nga ennene ey'ebintu bingi.
tips: Tandika n'ebigambo ebiri ku maaso, oluvannyuma ogattemu amalagala, emyenyuka oba obutonnyeza ku ludda lwabyo, buli kimu kimu.
Omuntu singa tayagala kukuba mifaanana, asobola okulonda amaloboozi oba okuwandiika obubaka.
Yogera ky'oyagala ku bitundu omuntu omulala by'akoze, so si oba birungi oba nedda.
Kuuma kaadi mu kifo w'esobola okuweebwa, oba kisigale ku mmeeza okutuusa kaakano.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa, manota, kubala mikono wadde okufiirwa. Osobola okuyimiriza ekiseera kyonna, era okuyimiriza wakati nakyo ngeri nnungi ey'okumaliriza.

faq.q: Tuyinza okwetaaga omugumba, emikasi oba stika?
faq.a: Nedda. Ebikaddiro eby'amaloboozi, emikasi egy'amaloboozi oba ebiwandiiko ebiriko ebyoya bimala. Tewali kyetaagisa kusala, kunywereza wadde kussaako.

faq.q: Tuyinza okukola kaadi ey'omukolo gwe ttaliimu ku lukalala?
faq.a: Londa "Just because" oluvannyuma owandiike ebigambo byo ku maaso, oba yonja kaadi awatali mukolo gwonna.

faq.q: Waliwo ekibalibwa, ekisalirwawo oba ekiterekebwa ku ssirini?
faq.a: Nedda. Olupapula lulaga kaadi n'emitendera gyokka. Tewali ekiteekebwa mu nteekateeka, kibalibwa oba kiterekebwa, era tewali kaadi ntuufu.
Olupapula lumu: kaadi evuddwa wakati, nga mulimu ebigambo by'omukolo n'ensalo ennyangu ku maaso, n'emirongo gy'obubaka n'ekigambo ekya From ku mabega. Amateeka ga bantu babiri gawandiikiddwa wansi.
Yee, kiwereddwa ddala, era tewali akaunti, kwewandiisa wadde okutikkula. Kikola ku web browser ku ssimu, ttabuleti oba kompyuta.

find-together.name: Find together
find-together.seoTitle: Find Together: Abantu Babiri Basanga Ebiragiro
find-together.h1: Find Together: Abantu Babiri, Ttiimu Emu
find-together.description: Abantu babiri bagabana ssirini emu era bakyusa okukyusa kaadi bbiri ez'ebifaananyi okunoonya ekibinja. Ebibinja bisangibwa awamu era bibalibwa ku kibalo kimu ekigabana. Kuzannya kwa bwereere, nga tewali ssaawa wadde manota.
find-together.short: Kyusa okuzannya n'omuntu ali kumpi naawe okunoonya ebibinja by'ebifaananyi.
find-together.intro: Kaadi zitandika nga ebifaananyi byazo biraga, oba osobola okuzisimba wansi. Ku kiseera kyo ogguka kaadi bbiri. Bwe zibeera ekibinja, mubasanze awamu era okukyusa kuyita eri omulala. Bwe zibeera ez'enjawulo, zisigala nga zirabika okutuusa ng'onyiga "Turn them back", ddala mulyoke mulabe bombi. Osobola okuyisa ekiseera kyonna. Ekibalo ekiri waggulu kyeyongera kyokka: ebibinja by'omusanze awamu.
howTo: Londa kaadi meka z'okukozesa. Kaadi mukaaga, ebibinja bisatu, kwe kutandika mu ngeri ey'emirembe.
Ekitundu kigamba ekiseera ky'ani, nga waliwo akabonzo ku muntu asooka ne kasanduuko ku muntu ow'okubiri.
Ggulawo kaadi bbiri, emu oluvannyuma lw'endala. Bwe zifaanagana, ekibinja kisangiddwa awamu.
Bwe zibeera ez'enjawulo, nyiga "Turn them back" bwe muba mwetegefu bombi. Okukyusa kuyita eri omulala.
Omu ku mmwe asobola okunyiga "Pass" ekiseera kyonna. Nyiga "Start again" okufuna kaadi empya, oba nyiga Rest okuyimiriza.
tips: Mutudde kumpi era mwogerere awamu amannya g'ebifaananyi: "Ekikopo ky'omwenge. Oyagala amata mu mwenge gwo?"
Leka omuntu gw'olabirira akube ku kitundu, n'oba kitwala ekiseera. Lagira n'olw'engalo okusinga okumukubira.
Londa "Cards face down" singa mombi musanyukira okugyusa kaadi okunoonya ebifaananyi.
Omuntu anaakoowa mangu asobola okuyisa ekiseera emirundi gyonna gy'ayagala. Ebibinja bikyasangibwa awamu.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali muwanguzi, kubanga musanga ebibinja nga ttiimu. Tewali ssaawa, tewali manota, era tewali kubala nsobi. Ekibalo kibala ebibinjaby'osanze awamu kyokka, era osobola okuyimiriza ekiseera kyonna.

faq.q: Tuteekwa okujjukira wa ebifaananyi we bali?
faq.a: Nedda. Zannya ritandika nga buli kifaananyi kirabika. Kaadi bwe zibeera nga zisimbiddwa wansi, musobola okubuuzaganya kye mwalabye, oba okuzigguka nate.

faq.q: Kiki ekibaawo kaadi bbiri bwe zibeera ez'enjawulo?
faq.a: Zisigala nga zirabika, mulyoke mulabe bombi, okutuusa ng'omala ekiseera ky'oyetaaga. Tewali kizikyusa yekka. Bw'obeera mwetegefu, nyiga "Turn them back" era okukyusa kuyita eri omuntu omulala.

faq.q: Waliwo ekyo kye tuzannya ekiterekebwa oba ekitumibwa?
faq.a: Nedda. Kaadi zisigala ku lupapula luno lwokka. Tewali kiterekebwa, kiteekebwa ku mutimbagano oba kibalibwa, era kiggwaawo bw'oggalawo olupapula.

faq.q: Kaadi zirina obunene obumala olw'okukankana oba essirini entono?
faq.a: Buli kaadi erina obugazi bwa pixels 64 ku bubwo, era ya nnene nga essirini bw'essobola. Abakozesa keyboard n'abasoma essirini bawulira buli kaadi ng'ekozesa ekifo kyayo n'ekifaananyi kyayo.
Yee, kiwereddwa ddala, era tewali akaunti, kwewandiisa wadde okutikkula. Kikola ku web browser ku ssimu, ttabuleti oba kompyuta.

story-dice.name: Story dice
story-dice.description: Dayisi ssatu oba ena ez'ebifaananyi okwogera olugero nazo, mu nsengeka yonna. Tewali kusoma, tewali nsonga ntuufu, tewali ssaawa wadde manota. Kuba nate, oba yisa. Kuzannya n'okukuba ku kompyuta kwa bwereere.
story-dice.short: Kuba dayisi z'ebifaananyi wamu oyogere olugero, mu nsengeka yonna.
story-dice.players: Abantu 2 oba okusingawo, oba omuntu omukulu n'omwana
story-dice.intro: Pictures are shown, like dice, three or four of them. Together, make up a story that uses them, in any order. A story can be one sentence or a few, and it can be silly or true to life. There is no right story, and nobody has to name or remember anything. Tap "Roll again" for new pictures, and anyone may pass.
howTo: Choose three or four dice. Three is the simplest.
Look at the pictures together. Tap one if you would like to begin with it.
Take turns telling a story that uses the pictures, in any order. One sentence each is plenty.
Anyone may pass. Tap "Pass" and the next person can start.
Tap "Roll again" for new pictures whenever you like, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Ask a question rather than waiting for an answer: "Where might the umbrella be going?"
Add to what the last person said instead of correcting it. Any story works.
A story can be about a real memory. A picture is a good start for one.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Do I need to read or name the pictures?
faq.a: No. The game works with the pictures alone. Players can point, describe or simply say what the picture reminds them of. Nobody is asked to name or recall anything.

faq.q: What if someone does not want to take a turn?
faq.a: They can pass at any time with no explanation. The game just waits, and the next person can start or you can roll again.
Yes. A one-page sheet has sixteen different pictures in four rows. Pick a row, or cut the pictures out and draw some from a pile.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Word and picture pairs
word-and-picture-pairs.seoTitle: Word and Picture Pairs: Match Words to Pictures
word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Word and Picture Pairs: Match the Word to the Picture
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Match English words to their pictures, and hear any word read aloud. Pictures stay in view, with no timer, score or count of tries. Free to play and print.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Match each word to its picture, and hear it read aloud.
word-and-picture-pairs.players: One adult, or a family playing side by side
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Four or six pictures are shown, with their English words in a different order. Tap a word and then its picture, or a picture and then its word. A matched pair stays together with a thick border and the word "Matched". Tap "Read aloud" beside any word to hear it spoken. Nothing is timed or scored, and a tap that does not match simply clears itself.
howTo: Choose four or six pictures. Four is the simplest.
Tap a word, then the picture it names. Or tap a picture first, then its word.
A matched pair stays together. A tap that does not match clears quietly, so try another.
Tap "Read aloud" beside a word to hear it, if your device can read text aloud.
Tap "New pictures" for another set, or "Start again" to take every pair apart. "Put it back" brings back the last matches.
tips: Say each word aloud together before you match it, and talk about the picture.
Families can take turns. Each person chooses one word or picture at a time.
Use the words you already know first, and leave the others for later.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.
It is made for adults learning or relearning English words, and for families playing side by side. It is not written for children.

faq.q: What if my device cannot read text aloud?
faq.a: The Read aloud button uses the voice your browser already has. If the browser cannot speak, the button is not shown and the game works without it.
Yes. A one-page sheet has six pictures and their six words, to cut out or to join with a line.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

sort-together.name: Sengeka awamu
sort-together.seoTitle: Sorting Game: Sort Together for Adults
sort-together.description: Tap a picture, then the basket it belongs in: kitchen or garden, fruit or animals. A calm, free sorting game for adults and families.
sort-together.short: Teeka buli kifaananyi mu kibbo kyakyo: effumbiro oba olusuku, n'ebirala.
sort-together.intro: Okusengeka mulimu gwa bulijjo ogumanyiddwa era oguleeta essanyu, gamba ng'okutereka ebintu ebiguliddwa oba okugatta sitokingizi ezifaanagana. Koona ku kifaananyi, oluvannyuma okoone ku kibbo we kisaana okuba. Tewali kwanguyiriza era tewali nsobi.
howTo: Londa omulamwa: effumbiro n'olusuku, ebibala n'ebisolo, oba eka n'olugendo.
Koona ku kifaananyi. Kifuna olukugiro lwa zaabu.
Koona ku kibbo mwe kisaana okuba. Ekifaananyi kigenda mu kibbo ekyo.
Bwe kiba kisaana kuba mu kibbo ekirala, omuzannyo gukiraga mu ngeri ey'empisa era ne gulinda.
Buli kifaananyi bwe kimala okusengekebwa, mutunulire awamu ebyateekeddwa mu bibbo.
tips: Mu bulamu obwa bulijjo emirundi mingi tewabaawo kuddamu kukyamu. Singa omuntu agamba nti ekipompo kisaana kuba mu ffumbiro, mubuuze ensonga. Oyinza okufunamu olugero olulungi.
Kozesa ebifaananyi okutandika emboozi: "Kiki kye watereka oba kye walima mu lusuku lwo?"
Okusengeka ebintu ebya ddala, gamba ng'amagiiko n'ewuma oba amapeesa ng'ogoberera langi, kintu kirungi nnyo ekiyinza okukolebwa oluvannyuma nga temuli ku sikuliini.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa, bubonero, kubala mirundi egy'okukwatako wadde okuwangulwa. Muyinza okuyimiriza ekiseera kyonna, era n'okukomya akayingiro wakati ngeri nnungi nnyo ey'okumalirizaamu.
Abantu bangi banyumirwa okusengeka kubanga kiba kiwulirika ng'omulimu ogugasa era ogumanyiddwa. Era kiba kyangu nnyo okwogerako ku bifaananyi nga bwe mugenda mu maaso.
Yee, kya bwereere, era tewali kwetaagisa akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuteeka kintu ku ssimu oba kompyuta. Kikola bulungi mu mukutu gw'okubaza ku ssimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.

picture-puzzle.name: Pazolo y'ebifaananyi
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Easy Online Jigsaw: 4 or 9 Large Pieces
picture-puzzle.description: An easy online jigsaw for adults: 4 or 9 large pieces, the whole picture stays visible, and you tap two pieces to swap them. Use your own photo, which stays on this device. Free, no timer.
picture-puzzle.short: Koona ku bitundu bibiri okubikyusa ebifo okutuusa ng'ekifaananyi kyonna kiweddeyo.
picture-puzzle.intro: A friendly picture is cut into four or nine large pieces and mixed up. The whole picture stays visible as a guide. Tap one piece, then another, and they swap places. No dragging is needed. You can also use one of your own photos. It stays on this device and is never uploaded.
howTo: Londa ekifaananyi n'ebitundu 4 oba 9. Ebitundu ebina kitandikilo kirungi era ekyangu.
Tunuulira ekifaananyi kyonna waggulu.
Koona ku kitundu, oluvannyuma okoone mu kifo we kisaana okugenda. Ebitundu ebyo ebibiri bikyusa ebifo.
Ebitundu ebiri mu kifo ekituufu bifuna akabonero akatono akalaga nti kituufu.
Ekifaananyi bwe kimala okujjula, mukisanyukireko mwenna awamu, oluvannyuma mulonde ekirala.
tips: Okukoona ku bitundu bibiri okubikyusa ebifo kwangu nnyo okusinga okubisika eri abantu bangi.
Mwogere ku kifaananyi nga bwe kigattibwa: "Akalanga akamyufu kaali awo."
Pazolo eya ddala ey'embaawo erimu ebitundu ebinene 12 okutuuka ku 24 nakyo kintu kirungi nnyo ekiyinza okuzannyirwa ku mmeeza.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa, bubonero, kubala mirundi egy'okukwatako wadde okuwangulwa. Muyinza okuyimiriza ekiseera kyonna, era n'okukomya akayingiro wakati ngeri nnungi nnyo ey'okumalirizaamu.
Nedda. Koona ku kitundu kimu, oluvannyuma okoone ku kirala, era ne bikyusa ebifo. Kino kyangu nnyo eri omuntu alina omukono ogukankana oba ng'akozesa sikuliini entono.
Yee, kya bwereere, era tewali kwetaagisa akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuteeka kintu ku ssimu oba kompyuta. Kikola bulungi mu mukutu gw'okubaza ku ssimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.

finish-the-saying.name: Maliriza olugero
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Finish the Saying: Familiar Sayings Game
finish-the-saying.description: Engero ez'Olumerika ezimanyiddwa ennyo ezibulamu ekigambo ekisembayo, gamba nga "A penny saved is a penny ___". Koona ku ky'olonze oba laga enkomerero, oluvannyuma mugyogerereko.
finish-the-saying.short: Mumalirize awamu engero ezimanyiddwa, oluvannyuma muzinyumyeeko.
finish-the-saying.intro: Engero enkadde emirundi mingi zimanyibwa obulamu bwonna. Buli kaada eraga olugero olumanyiddwa ng'ekigambo ekisembayo tekiriiko, ebyokulondako bisatu, ne peesa erigamba nti "Laga enkomerero". Oluvannyuma lw'enkomerero, ekibuuzo ekiteefu kiyitawo emboozi.
howTo: Musome olugero mu ddoboozi eriwulikika mwenna awamu.
Koona ku kigambo ekirumaliriza, oba koona ku "Laga enkomerero".
Musome olugero lwonna nate era mukubaganye ebirowoozo nga mukozesa ekibuuzo ekikubiriza emboozi.
Koona ku "Olugero oluddako" nga mwetegekedde.
tips: Musome mpolampola era muwummuleko katono nga temunnatuuka ku kigambo ekisembayo. Emirundi mingi abantu bakyogerako nga tonnakimaliriza.
Omuntu bw'awaayo enkomerero ey'enjawulo, mukisanyukireko. Enkozesa z'engero ezimu zaawukana okusinziira ku ffamire oba ekitundu.
Mu kibiina, omuntu omu asoma ate abalala bonna ne bamaliriza wamu enkomerero.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa ebala biseera, bubonero, kubala mirundi gigendeddwamu wadde okuwangulwa. Muyinza okuyimirira akaseera konna, era n'okukoma wakati ngeri nnungi nnyo ey'okumalirizaamu.

faq.q: Bwe tulonda ekigambo ekirala kiba kitya?
faq.a: Omuzannyo gulaga enkomerero eya bulijjo ne gukwasa emboozi. Tewali bubonero, era n'okuddamu okw'enjawulo kukkirizibwa bulungi.
Yee, bwa bwereere, era tewali akaawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuteekamu pulogulaamu. Bukolera bulungi mu mukutu gwa yintaneeti ku ssimu, tabuleeti oba kompyuta.

word-search.name: Okunoonya ebigambo mu nnukuta ennene
word-search.seoTitle: Large Print Word Search, Free and Printable
word-search.description: A free large-print word search for older adults and families. Few words, big letters, words across and down only. Play online or print.
word-search.short: Ennukuta nnene, ebigambo bitono, bisimbiddwa oba byebise byokka. Gukube ne ku lupapula.
word-search.intro: Akaboozi katono akalimu ennukuta ennene n'ebigambo bitonotono, byonna nga bisomebwa bwebise oba bisimbiddwa. Koona ku nnukuta y'ekigambo ey'olubereberye, oluvannyuma koona ku nnukuta yaakyo esembayo. Mwagala lupapula? Kuba omuzannyo omupya ku lupapula n'okukoona kumwe kwokka.
howTo: Londa omutwe gw'ebigambo n'obunene bw'akaboozi.
Kebera olukalala lw'ebigambo. Ebigambo bisomebwa bwebise (okuva ku kkono okudda ku ddyo) oba bisimbiddwa (okuva waggulu okudda wansi).
Koona ku nnukuta y'ekigambo ey'olubereberye, oluvannyuma koona ku nnukuta yaakyo esembayo.

garden-planner.seoTitle: Havebedsplanlægger: Læg en plan ud fra plantebilleder
garden-planner.h1: Havebedsplanlægger: Vælg billeder og læg en plan ud
garden-planner.description: Vælg billeder af planter og havetingvæsen, og placer dem i tolv bede på en parcel. Tryk på et billede og derefter på et bed. Ingen timer og ingen point. Gratis at spille og printe.
garden-planner.short: Vælg plantebilleder og læg en plan med tolv bede.
garden-planner.players: Alene, eller 2 personer side om side
garden-planner.intro: Vælg billeder fra en bakke med planter og havetting, og tryk derefter på et bed for at sætte hvert billede på plads. En parcel har tolv bede, og et bed rummer ét billede. En opsummering med ord viser, hvad planen indeholder, fx "Din plan har 3 solsikker, 2 roser og 1 træ." Intet tages tid på, intet tælles, intet gemmes, og der er ingen tur. Dette er en billedplan at tale om, ikke plantningsråd. "Print planen" printer bedene med de valgte billeder, med tomme bede at tegne i og linjer til noter.
howTo: Tryk på et billede i bakken. Der står "Valgt", mens det er markeret.
Tryk på et bed. Billedet lægges der, og valget er afgjort.
For at ændre et bed vælges et andet billede, og så trykkes på bedet. For at tømme et bed trykkes på det uden at have valgt et billede.
Tryk på "Start forfra" for at tømme alle bede, og "Læg det tilbage", hvis du skifter mening.
Tryk på "Print planen" for en papirkopi af parcellen og opsummeringen.
tips: Nyonyola buli kifaananyi bwe kigenda mu kifo kyakyo, nga, "enkoko ya kiwojjolo egenda ku nnyumba y'ennyonyi". Okwogera wamu kifuula omulimu ogw'awamu.
Buli muntu alonde ekifaananyi bwe kijja, oba mulonde ebifaananyi awamu, buli omu asobole okuwa endowooza ye ku nkulaakulana y'ekifaananyi.
Ku lupapula, ebitundu ebitaliimu biwandiiko bya kukozesebwa okukubako ebirowoozo byo, n'emirongo gy'okuwandiikako gya bintu by'oyagala okujjukira.

faq.q: Kino kye kiwabulwa ku nsimbi z'ebimera?
faq.a: Nedda. Kino kyapulaani ya bifaananyi ey'okwogerako, si ndagiriro ku kusimba ebimera. Tekiraga ddi, wa, oba engeri y'okusimba ekintu kyonna, kubanga kino kisinziira ku w'obeera.
Nedda. Tewali kiseera kipimibwa, tewali manota gaweebwa, tewali kubalibwa, era tewali awangula. Olusuku oluggyeemu buli kimu terufuna bubaka bwa njawulo.

faq.q: Ebifaananyi bye tulonze bitereezebwa oba bitumibwa?
faq.a: Nedda. Pulaani esigala ku lupapula luno lwokka. Tetereezebwa, tetuumibwa, era tebalibwa, era ebula bw'oggalawo lupapula.

Yee. "Kuba pulaani" ekuba lupapula lumu, ku A4 oba US Letter. Lulaga ebitundu ebikumi bibiri mu bibiri n'ebifaananyi bye walonze, okufunza mu bigambo, n'emirongo emitaliimu biwandiiko ogya okuwandiikako.

faq.q: Kiri ku bwereere, era nneetaaga okwewandiisa?
faq.a: Yee, kiri ku bwereere, era tewali akawunti, kwewandiisa, oba okutikka. Kikola ku browsa ya yintaneeti ku ssimu, kompyuta ey'omu ngalo, oba kompyuta.

coloring-wall.name: Bbugwe ow'okusiiga awamu
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Bbugwe ow'Okusiiga Awamu: Ekifaananyi Kimu Ku Mikono Mingi
coloring-wall.h1: Bbugwe ow'Okusiiga Awamu: Ekifaananyi Ekinene Kimu, Nga Kisiigibwa Awamu
coloring-wall.description: Kuba ekifaananyi ekinene kimu ku mpapula ez'enjawulo, ab'omu maka, abasomesa oba abantu ab'omu nnyumba y'okulabirira basobole okusiiga bbugwe omu awamu. Kiri ku bwereere okukuba. Tewali kiseera oba manota.
coloring-wall.short: Kuba ekifaananyi ekinene ku mpapula eziwerako abantu bangi basiige.
coloring-wall.players: Ekibinja, ku mmeeza oba ku bbugwe
coloring-wall.intro: Londa ekifaananyi ku mpapula ez'okusiiga, n'bbugwe ow'empapula 4, 6 oba 9. Kuba bbugwe: lupapula olusooka lulaga engeri y'okugukolamu, era buli lupapula olulala kitundu kimu ku kifaananyi ekinene ekimu, nga kiriko ekikonsolo ekiringa A1 mu nsonda yaako. Buli muntu asiige lupapula lumu oba okusingawo, mu langi yonna ne mu mpisa yonna. Empapula kati ziteekebwa ng'ogoberera ebikonsolo byazo, ne zisibibwa wamu n'akasolo ku ddaala ery'emabega. Tewali kiseera, manota oba kutereka.
howTo: Londa ekifaananyi, oluvannyuma londa empapula bbugwe gy'alina.
Soma maapu ey'oku ssirini, eraga buli kikonsolo gy'ekiteekebwa.
Nyiga "Kuba bbugwe" okube empapula zonna.
Wa buli muntu lupapula lumu oba okusingawo okusiiga. Langi n'empisa tezirina kwenkana.
Teeka empapula ng'ogoberera ebikonsolo byazo, zisibe wamu n'akasolo ku ddaala ery'emabega.
tips: Wa empapula ezirina ensalo ennyangu abantu abaagala omulimu ogutaliimu mulabe, n'ezo ezirimu ebintu bingi abantu abasanyukira ebyo.
Kwata bbugwe mu kifo buli omu lw'asobola okulaba, era mwogerere wamu ku bitundu byagyo.
Londa bbugwe omutono ku mmeeza entono, ne ddene ku kisenge ekinene.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali kiseera kipimibwa, tewali manota gaweebwa oba kubalibwa, era tewali awangula. Bbugwe ye kifaananyi kimu abantu bangi kye basiizza.
Nedda. Bbugwe akolebwa ku lupapula luno lwokka. Tetereezebwa, tetuumibwa, era tebalibwa, era ebula bw'oggalawo lupapula.
Nedda. Buli muntu asobola okukozesa langi yonna ne mpisa yonna. Empapula zisigala nga zisibibwa wamu ne zifuuka ekifaananyi kimu.
Yee. Bbugwe ow'ekiwandiiko ye mwannyo gwonna: lupapula olusooka olulimu emitendera ne maapu, n'olupapula olumu eri buli kitundu ky'ekifaananyi.

faq.q: Kiri ku bwereere, era nneetaaga okwewandiisa?
faq.a: Yee, kiri ku bwereere, era tewali akawunti, kwewandiisa, oba okutikka. Kikola ku browsa ya yintaneeti ku ssimu, kompyuta ey'omu ngalo, oba kompyuta.

quiet-shapes.name: Puzzle y'ebifaananyi ebitaliimu ddoboozi
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Puzzle y'Ebifaananyi ebitaliimu Ddoboozi: Teeka Ebifaananyi mu Kifaananyi
quiet-shapes.h1: Puzzle y'Ebifaananyi ebitaliimu Ddoboozi: Teeka Ebitundu mu Kifaananyi
quiet-shapes.description: Teeka ebifaananyi ebyangu mu nsalo y'ennyumba, eryato, ekyennyanja n'ebirala. Kwata ekitundu, oluvannyuma ekifo ekirina ekifaananyi kye kimu. Tewali kiseera oba manota. Kiri ku bwereere okuzannya n'okukuba.
quiet-shapes.short: Teeka ebifaananyi ebyangu mu kifaananyi, ng'okola ku bbanga lyo.
quiet-shapes.intro: Ensalo y'ekifaananyi, nga ennyumba, eryato oba roketi, egabanyizibwamu ebifo. Buli kifo kirina ekitundu ekirina ekifaananyi kye kimu: triyangiro ennene oba entono, sikweya, parallelogram oba rectangle. Kwata ekitundu, oluvannyuma kwata ekifo ekirina ekifaananyi kimu, kikwatagana. Ekifo kikyusa ekitundu mu kifo ekituufu, nga tokyusa wadde okukaza. Ekitundu bwe kiba nga kya kifaananyi kya njawulo ku kifo, kiri mu kibbo n'ekiwandiiko ekimpi. Tewali kiseera oba manota, era tewali kutereka oba kutuma. "Kuba ekifaananyi kino" ekuba ensalo n'ebitundu byayo ku lupapula lumu okusiiga oba okusalako.
howTo: Kwata ekitundu mu kibbo. Kiraga "Kirondeddwa" nga kirondeddwa.
Kwata ekifo mu kifaananyi. Ekifaananyi bwe kiba nga kikwatagana, ekitundu kigyeko.
Bwe kitakwatagana, gezaako ekifo ekirala. Tewali ky'ofiirwa olw'okugezaako.
Kwata ekitundu mu kifaananyi okukiddiza mu kibbo, oba kozesa "Tandika nate" okukiddiza byonna.
Ebifo byonna bwe bimala okuba n'ebitundu byabyo, ekifaananyi kiba kimaze. Nyiga "Ekifaananyi ekirala" ku kirala, oba nyiga Okuwummula okusirika.
tips: Ggulawo ennyiriri ez’okuyamba okulaba buli kifo. Zizimye bw’oba oyagala ekizibu ekisingako, ng’olina ensalo yokka okukutungamya.
Tandika n’ebifaananyi ebinene, gamba “triangle” ennene ne “rectangle”. Ebitundu ebitono bitera okuteekebwa oluvannyuma.
Yogera mu ddoboozi ng’ogenda mu maaso: “Triangle, square, rectangle empanvu.” Okwogera kiyinza okufuula ekikolwa kino eky’abantu bombi.
Ku lupapula, siiga ebitundu n’langi bbiri oba ssatu, oba osale nga omuntu omukulu akuyamba.

faq.q: Waliwo ekipimo ky’obudde, obubonero oba omuwendo gw’entambula?
faq.a: Nedda. Tewali kubalirira budde, kubalirira mirundi wadde okuwa obubonero. Ekitundu ekitasaanira tekiteekebwa, era osobola okuyimirira ddi lwoyagala.

faq.q: Ekyo kye tukola kitereezebwa oba kisindikibwa?
faq.a: Nedda. Ekifaananyi kisigala ku mukutu guno gwokka. Tekitereezebwa, tekisindikibwa wadde okubalirirwa, era kibula bw’oggalawo omukutu.

faq.q: Ebifo binene okusobola okukankana kw’emikono oba essimu ento?
faq.a: Ensalo eyolekebwa nga nnene nga essira lisobola, era buli kifo kiba bbaatuni osobola okukituukako n’engalo oba n’ekisumuluzo Tab. Ebitundu ebiri mu ttereyi bbaatuni ennene ez’omukutu guno.

Yee. “Kuba ekifaananyi kino” ekuba ekifaananyi kimu ku lupapula lumu: ensalo n’ennyiriri zaayo ez’okuyamba, n’ebitundu nga bisangibwa ku mabbali nga binene bumu. Siiga ebitundu, oba osale ebitundu okubikwatiza. Omuntu omukulu asobola okukusalirako.
Yee, kya buwa, era tewali akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuwanula. Kikola mu browsa y’essimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.

calm-breathing.name: Okwissa mu mirembe
calm-breathing.description: Okuwummulamu okw'akaboozi akasaale mu kussa: enkulungo empolempole egejja n'ekendeeva okumala emikka mukaaga. Mugitandika mmwe, era muyinza okugiyimiriza ekiseera kyonna.
calm-breathing.short: Enkulungo empolempole gye mwissizaako. Gitandike era ogiyimirize nga bw'oyagala.
calm-breathing.intro: Oluusi ekintu ekisinga obulungi kwe kuba n'akaseera ak'okuwummulamu mu kasirise. Nyiga ku "Tandika", oluvannyuma osse omukka ng'enkulungo eno egejja era ogufulumye ng'ekendeeva. Londa emisinde empola oba amangwago. Guno si musawo wadde obujjanjabi, kaseera ka ddembe na kukkakkana ka kugabanira wamu.
howTo: Mutuule obulungi nga mutudde wamu.
Mwerondere emisinde: empola oba ey'akaboozi akasaale.
Nyiga ku "Tandika". Ssa omukka munda ng'enkulungo egejja, era ogufulumye ng'ekendeeva.
Eyimirira yokka oluvannyuma lw'emikka mukaaga, oba nyiga ku "Yimiriza" ekiseera kyonna kye mwagadde.
tips: Mukwatagane mu ngalo oba teeka omukono gwo ku mukono gw'omuntu gw'olabirira singa aba akiwulira bulungi.
Temukaka muntu n'akamu. Singa baagala kutunulako butunuzi, ekyo kiba kirungi nnyo.
Singa omuntu aba n'obuzibu mu kussa, assenga bulijjo era atunuulire obutunuulizi enkulungo eno. Buuza omusawo ku nsonga zonna ezikwata ku kussa.

faq.a: Nedda. Kaseera kangu era ak'okwerondera ak'okukkakkana n'okubeerako wamu. Si bujjanjabi bwa kweraliikirira wadde obulwadde obulala bwonna. Tegeezezzaako omusawo ku nsonga zonna ez'obulamu.

faq.q: Enkulungo eno etambula nga nze ssi gitandise?
faq.a: Nedda. Tewali kintu kyonna ekitambula okutuusa lw’onyiga Okutandika, era kiyimirira oluvannyuma lw’okussa emirundi mukaaga oba lw’onyiga Okulekera awo. Singa ekyuma kyo kitegekeddwa okukendeeza ku ntambula, ebigambo bikyuka nga enkulungo teyeeyongera bunene.
Yee, kya bwereere, era tekyetaagisa akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuwanula. Kikola mu mutimbagano gw’omu ssimu, tabuleeti oba kompyuta.

story-chain.name: Olujegere lw’ebifaananyi
story-chain.h1: Olujegere lw’Ebifaananyi: Mugambe Olugero Ekifaananyi Ekimu Ekimu
story-chain.description: Omurongo gw’ebifaananyi gukula ekimu ekimu, era buli muntu ayogera mu ddoboozi ekigerere kimu ku kyo. Tewali kuwandiika, tewali eky’okuddamu ekituufu. Kya buwa, kikakkana, nga tewali kubalirira budde wadde obubonero.
story-chain.short: Ssa ekifaananyi, oluvannyuma buli muntu ayogere ekigerere kimu, mu bukyukiro.
story-chain.intro: Omuzannyo gutandika n’ekifaananyi kimu ne gukula olujegere ekifaananyi ekimu ekimu. Buli muntu ayogera ekigerere kimu ku lujegere lwonna olutuuse, mu ddoboozi, mu bukyukiro. Ekigerere kiyinza okukwata ku ky’olaba, ekifo ekikujjukiza oba ekintu ekisanyusa. Tewali kiwandiikibwa, tekikuumibwa, tewali eky’okuddamu ekituufu, era buli muntu asobola okuyisa. Olujegere lukoma ku bifaananyi munaana, oluvannyuma osobola okutandika olulala.
howTo: Tunuulira wamu ekifaananyi ekisooka.
Mukyukiragana: buli muntu ayogera ekigerere kimu ku lujegere lwonna olutuuse. Buli muntu asobola okuyisa.
Kuba “Ssa ekifaananyi” okussa ekifaananyi ekiddako ku nkomerero y’olujegere.
Kuba “Ggyawo eyasembayo” bw’oba oyagala okuddayo ku kifaananyi ekyasooka.
Olujegere bwe lunaaba n’ebifaananyi munaana, kuba “Tandika olujegere oluggya” olw’olulala, oba oyimirire.
tips: Ekigambo ekimpi nakyo kirungi: “Omuntu ateeka amazzi ku muliro.” Omuntu addako asobola okugenda mu maaso oba okuyisa.
Ebifaananyi bikulembere. Tewali kyafaayo kyonna ky’olina okutuuka ku kyo.
Yimirira ddi lw’oyagala. Okuyimirira wakati kisobola okuba engeri ennungi ey’okumaliriza.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali kipimo kya budde, bubonero, muwendo gw’entambula wadde okufiirwa. Osobola okuyimirira ku kaseera kyonna, era okuyimirira wakati kisobola okuba engeri ennungi ey’okumaliriza.
Nedda. Ebigerere byogerwa mu ddoboozi era tebiwandiikibwa, tebikuumibwa wadde okusindikibwa mu bifo ebirala. Omuzannyo kulaga bifaananyi byokka.

faq.q: Kiki singa omuntu tayagala kwogera kintu kyonna?
faq.a: Buli muntu asobola okuyisa, era oyo addirira agenda mu maaso. Tewali muntu yeetaagisa okutuuma oba okujjukira ekifaananyi.
Yee, kya buwa, era tewali akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuwanula. Kikola mu browsa y’essimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.

quiet-scene.name: Embeera ekkakkamu
quiet-scene.h1: Embeera Ekkakkamu: Ekifaananyi Ekitatambula Kimu Kimu
quiet-scene.description: Ekifaananyi ekinene, ekitatambula kimu kimu, buli kimu nga kiriko ennyiriri emu ennyimpi wansi. Nyiga “Ekiddako” oba “Ekyasooka” bw’oba weetegese. Tewali kitambula wadde kivuga kyekka, era tewali budde wadde obubonero. Kya buwa, nga tewali akawunti.
quiet-scene.short: Tunuulira ekifaananyi kimu ekitatambula, nga bw’oyagala.
quiet-scene.players: Ggwe wekka, oba kibinja mu kisenge kimu
quiet-scene.intro: Ekifaananyi ekinene kijjula essirini, nga wansi waakyo waliwo ennyiriri emu ennyimpi. Nyiga “Ekifaananyi ekiddako” oba “Ekifaananyi ekyasooka” bw’oba weetegese okulaba ekirala. Tewali kitambula, tewali kikyuka wadde okukyuka kyekka, era tewali budde bulabirirwa. Kuba “Ekifaananyi ekinene” okulaga ekifaananyi kyokka, buli muntu mu kisenge alyoke akiraba ku ttivi.
howTo: Tunuulira ekifaananyi wamu.
Soma ennyiriri ewansi waakyo mu ddoboozi bw’oba oyagala.
Nyiga “Ekifaananyi ekiddako” oba “Ekifaananyi ekyasooka” bw’oba weetegese.
Kuba “Ekifaananyi ekinene” okulaga ekifaananyi kyokka, n’“Laga byonna” okuddiza ebirala.
Yimirira ddi lw’oyagala n’“Ntuukiridde kati”.
tips: Leka omuntu alonde ddi lw’anaagendera mu maaso: mulindirire alabe, olwo nyiga “Ekiddako”.
Ku kibinja, kozesa “Ekifaananyi ekinene” ku ttivi oba essirini ennene, otuule we bonna bayinza okukiraba.
Tewali ngeri nnamba ey’okutunuulira ekifaananyi. Okwogera ku kyo kyokka kye kikolwa ekituukiridde.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali kipimo kya budde, bubonero, muwendo gw’entambula wadde okufiirwa. Osobola okuyimirira ku kaseera kyonna, era okuyimirira wakati kisobola okuba engeri ennungi ey’okumaliriza.
Nedda. Tewali kuvuga, era tewali kitambula, kiggwaawo wadde okukyuka mu bunene bwakyo. Ekifaananyi kikyuka bw’onyiga bbaatuni yokka.
Nedda. Eno ye kifaananyi okulabirako awamu ku ssirini. Ekifaananyi kyo oba postkaadi gy'oyagala ku mmeeza kikola kye kimu.
Yee, kya bwereere, era tewali akaunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuwanula. Kikola mu browser y'essimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.

color-wash.name: Okunaaza langi
color-wash.seoTitle: Okunaaza Langi: Langi Ennyonjo ku Lupapula
color-wash.h1: Okunaaza Langi: Siiga Langi Ennyonjo ku Lupapula
color-wash.description: Bbulosi enyonjo esiiga langi ennene, ezitangaala ku lupapula lumu, mu langi ana n'obunene bubiri bwa bbulosi. Tewali nkomerero, tewali bigezi wadde ekiseera. Kikozesebwa bwereere, nga tekyetaagisa akaunti.
color-wash.short: Siiga langi ennyonjo ku lupapula, ng'oyita mu sipiidi yo.
color-wash.players: Wekka, oba abantu 2 ku ludda lumu
color-wash.intro: Lupapula lumu n'bbulosi emu enyonjo. Londa langi n'obunene bwa bbulosi, oluvannyuma nkuba bbulosi ku lupapula okuteekawo okunaaza kwa langi. Lupapula teririna nkomerero: tewali kintu kya kumaliriza, tewali kifaananyi kya kutuukirira wadde amanota. Teeka okunaaza kwo nga bwe oyagala, oba oteeke bbulosi wansi olabe nga bugumu. Lupapula empya eggyawo byonna, era Zzaayo ekizzaayo.
howTo: Londa langi. Buli langi erina erinnya lyayo eriwandiikibwa.
Londa Gazi oba Gazi nnyo. Gazi nnyo ebikka ekitundu ekisingawo ku lupapula buli kakubo.
Kuba bbulosi ku lupapula n'olubatu, ekkalaamu oba ppeni okuteekawo okunaaza.
Oba kozesa obusaale okusengula empeta ya bbulosi, ne Space okuteeka bbulosi wansi oba okugiggyayo.
Nyiga "Lupapula empya" okuyonja lupapula, oluvannyuma "Zzaayo ekizzaayo" singa oyagala okunaaza okwo okuddemu.
tips: Muleke omuntu omulala alonde langi ya kunaaza okuddako, era mwogere ku langi nga zikolebwa.
Gazi nnyo ya bwangu okufuga n'omukono oguyinyiza, kubanga bbulosi teyeetaagisa kuba ntuufu nnyo.
Tewali ngeri nkyamu ey'okusiiga langi. Yimiriza buli kiseera oyagala, oba nyiga "Kimaze okutuuka wano".

faq.a: Nedda. Lupapula teririna nkomerero. Tewali kintu ekimaliriziddwa, ekibalibwa, ekipimibwa ekiseera oba ekiweebwa amanota, era tewali bubaka bwonna obukusaba okukola ebisingawo.
Nedda. Tewali kintu ekitereezebwa, ekisindikibwa oba ekiweerezebwa wadde wa. Okunaaza kusigala ku lupapula luno okutuusa lw'ova mu lupapula.

faq.q: Nsobola okukozesa awatali mouse oba ssirini ekwatibwako?
faq.a: Yee. Lupapula bwe lubeera lunnyonnyoddwa, obusaale busengula empeta ya bbulosi, ne kkiyi ya Space eteeka bbulosi wansi oba eginyusa. Ssirini eyogera nti "Bbulosi wansi" oba "Bbulosi waggulu" buli lwe kikolebwa.
Nedda. Okusiiga langi ya watercolor ku lupapula kye kimu, bbulosi ennyogovu n'langi emu mu kiseera, kale ye mirimu gy'enjawulo gy'osobola okugezaako ku mmeeza.

Kiragala, kobaggwanga, kiragala ekibisi ne kakobe, langi ennya ze zimu ezikozesebwa mu bizannyo byaffe ebirala ebya kifaananyi. Buli emu erina erinnya eriwandiikiddwa, era erinnya lirabika okumpi n'okulonda.
Yee, kya bwereere, era tewali akaunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuwanula. Kikola mu browser y'essimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.
